# dsh-balance-usage-dock
A zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds one cell to the **composer dock**: the bal
ance of the provider you are currently using plus the cumulative estimated cost of the session, incl
uding every subagent session it spawned. Click the cell for a panel with all providers, quotas, prov
ider-reported spend, a 90-day heatmap and the per-model breakdown.
- Runs locally only: one read-only loopback/same-origin HTTP route, no telemetry, no browser storage

, no credential persistence.
- **No price table is compiled in.** Prices are fetched at runtime from
the provider's own catalog, user catalogs, the official DeepSeek price page or `models.dev` — the U

I always names the source and its confidence.
- No floating widget, no sidebar, no bundled artwork.
## Features (v0.2)

- **Model-following dock** — the balance target follows the model-selection directory
(`ctx.modelDir

ectories`), so switching provider/model updates the balance immediately while the
session cost keeps

accumulating (switches never reset it).
- **Cumulative, whole-tree session cost** — tokens, costs a

nd `byModel` cover the session plus every
reachable subagent session; fork-inherited history (`seq <

inheritedEventCount`) is skipped so a
fork never double-bills its parent. `mixedProviders` flags cr

oss-provider accumulation and
`pricingConfidence` reports the weakest price source used (`exact | fa

mily | community | override | none`).
- **Multi-currency, never summed across currencies** — CNY and

USD are shown side by side.
- **Peak / off-peak pricing** — official CNY prices are applied in the

IANA `peakTimeZone`
(default `Asia/Shanghai`), with configurable `peakWindows`, `peakWeekdays` and `

holidays`.
- **Resilient transport** — bounded retries, per-provider `peerTimeoutMs`, a whole-handle

r
`requestTimeoutMs`, `retryable`/`stale`/`degraded` flags, and `refresh=1` cache bypasses.
- **16 p

rovider kinds** — DeepSeek (API key and desktop account), Moonshot, OpenRouter, xAI,
Vercel AI Gatew

ay, Z.ai, MiniMax, Kimi Coding, OpenCode, OpenAI and Anthropic admin spend,
GitHub Copilot, OpenAI C

odex OAuth, Volcengine Ark agent/coding plans. See
docs/providers.md.
- **90-day heatmap** with day

bucketing in `statsTimeZone` and bounded session scanning.
- **Safe diagnostics** — `?kind=diagnosti

cs` produces a redacted snapshot you can paste into an
issue: no token/credential values, no account
profile, no session content.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness desktop with the browser `webServer` service (the plugin registers one route).
-

Node.js 22 or newer in the host (24 recommended). The plugin has no npm dependencies and no build
st
ep; the browser half is a single `client.js` module-loader bundle.
## Install

Install through the harness — do **not** edit the profile's `package.json` or
`cordis.patch.yml` by
hand. The plugin registers one read-only route and one composer-dock cell.
### From GitHub (recommended)
In a DSH session, ask the agent:

> Install the DSH plugin `github:YusenZhang0601/dsh-balance-usage-dock` with `plugin_manager`
> (`in
stall_bundle`), enable it if it is disabled, then verify it loaded.
For a `dsh web` profile, the CLI equivalent is:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout (development)

> Install the local DSH plugin at `<absolute path>/dsh-balance-usage-dock` with `plugin_manager`
> (
`install_bundle`), enable it if it is disabled, then verify it loaded.
### After installing
`plugin_manager` reports whether a restart is required. Then:

1. `cordis_inspect_query` (Client → `Slots`) should list `conversation.composer.dock` with the
`bala

nce-usage` cell and `shell.overlay` with the `balance-usage-panel`.
2. Refresh the browser page. If

installation returned `restart-required`, fully quit the desktop
client (including the tray) and reo

ation returned `restart-required`, fully quit the desktop
client (including the tray) and reopen it.
### From npm

Once the package is published: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-balance-usage-dock`, or the same
`p

lugin_manager` flow with the package name. Publishing is a manual workflow:
`.github/workflows/publi
sh.yml` (requires the `NPM_TOKEN` secret).
## Configuration (v0.2)
Every key is optional and lives in the plugin line's `config` (normally `cordis.patch.yml`); values
are clamped to the documented ranges. Full reference with examples: docs/configuration.md.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- No persistence in the browser: no `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB`, cookies or
filesy

stem writes; the client keeps an in-memory module store only.
- Credentials are resolved per request

through `ctx.credentials` (or the `apiKeyEnv` environment
fallback), never cached, logged or echoed

. Responses never contain credential values, account
profile data or session content.
- Outbound req

uests are limited to the price sources you enable and the providers you configured.
See docs/privacy
.md for the full outbound host list and diagnostics redaction.
## Limitations

- **Estimates only.** Numbers are computed from local session events × runtime prices; provider
bill

ing, discounts and mid-turn price changes are not modelled.
- **Official price parsing is structural

.** If the DeepSeek page changes shape the parser degrades
(warning + last known table). Keep `price

Overrides` or `extraPriceCatalogs` as a fallback.
- `models.dev` is a community catalog and may lag;

it is labelled `community` in the UI.
- Third-party relays usually expose neither balance nor price

APIs: they show no balance, and cost
needs `priceOverrides` / `extraPriceCatalogs`.
- Holiday handl

ing is a static `holidays` list; it does not auto-import a calendar.
- Subagent rollup needs the `su

bagents` service; if it is missing the dock shows the parent session
only (`subagent.unavailable: tr

ue`).
- The visual layer is verified by slot registration and API payloads; this repository has no b

rowser
automation.
- `openai-codex`, Volcengine Ark and GitHub Copilot adapters are fixture-tested,

not live-account
tested.
